name: Bradley S. Keller
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Bradley S. Keller is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Seattle, Washington area. Providing legal representation in Washington for a variety of different issues, Bradley Keller was selected to Super Lawyers for 1999, 2001 - 2026.

After completing undergraduate studies, Bradley S. Keller attended law school. Bradley Keller was enrolled at Brooklyn Law School. He earned a juris doctor degree in 1979. Bradley Keller was admitted to the practice of law in 1980.

Attorneys like Bradley S. Keller are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Bradley Keller represents clients with Business Litigation issues. Additional legal issues represented include Professional Liability: Defense and Securities Litigation.
